newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers dip, Med steady as demand tails off.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers dip, Med steady as demand tails off.

text.p: ARA bunker prices dipped on Thursday, while prices in southern Europe were steady, and demand all over the region tailed off, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST was valued at around $119 fob, partly in response to the slump in the barge market on Wednesday and also the slowing of bunker demand after two healthy days of business.

Overall ARA demand was thin. Some ship owners who did enquire after product were put off by continuing ice-related problems along waterways and the surcharges applicable. A surcharge of $1/$1.50 a tonne applied to Antwerp deliveries
"Some buyers have simply decided to pay a bit more.
"They avoid the difficulties by buying elsewhere," one supplier said.
Hamburg bunkers similarly came off. Business was also thin, many ship owners also deterred by delivery problems.
The Mediterranean was free of difficulties, but business was also relatively thin. Prices were stable at almost all ports.
However, demand at Gibraltar remained healthy.
Egyptian prices weakened by around $2 a tonne as supply difficulties looked set to end.
Bunkers in Fujairah also fell by $2 in reaction to Singapore weakness. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
